semiconductor_relevance: High — HIROXKOREA specializes in advanced optical microscopes that are essential for inspection and measurement in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: HIROXKOREA CO., LTD. develops and manufactures advanced 3D digital microscopes designed for precise measurement and analysis in semiconductor applications. Their products, such as the HRX-02 and HRX-01, offer capabilities for measuring various dimensions and surface characteristics, making them valuable tools for quality control and inspection processes.
capabilities: 3D measurement of length, height, angle, area, R value, and surface roughness
High-resolution side observation and rotation observation
Expandable microscope features for tailored applications
Electric motion control for Z-axis, X-Y, magnification, and lighting
